question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Of**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Of**' is used to indicate possession, belonging, or association.

 
 
• **Example**: *The colour of the sky is blue.*
 
 
 
• ​In the given context, "**of**" is the appropriate preposition in this context to convey the relationship between friendship and human life, indicating that friendship is one of the key elements or aspects within the realm of human experience.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On**: Indicates a position, location, or surface.
 
• **For**: Indicates purpose, duration, or reason.
 
• **By**: Indicates the agent or means by which an action is done.
